settings.title: Choose your plan
settings.text: Several single-flavor boxes every month, or one box a month that rotates.

settings.title: Pick your flavors
settings.text: Choose how many boxes of each flavor, or the flavors and order for your rotation.

settings.title: We ship monthly
settings.text: Eight bars per box, packed and shipped to your door every month.

settings.question: How does the rotating box work?
settings.answer: You pick the flavors you want and the order. Each month we send one box of the next flavor in your rotation, then start again from the top.

settings.question: Can I get more than one box a month?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose “Pick your boxes” and add as many boxes of each flavor as you like. They all ship together each month.

settings.question: Can I change my flavors later?
settings.answer: Yes. Get in touch through our Contact page and we'll update your boxes or your rotation.

settings.question: Can I skip or cancel?
settings.answer: Yes. Skip a delivery, pause or cancel any time from your account.

settings.heading: The Passport Box
settings.text: Eight bars of one flavor in every box, delivered monthly. Get a few flavors every month, or one box that rotates through your favorites.
